keyPhrases.text: the news is all to the good
plenty effective in its new Off Broadway guise
Kevin Adams' lighting design is an improvement over the original
not so provocative as it was back in 1996
current crop can't be expected to compete

reasoning: Strong positive review with clear recommendation. Opens and closes positively, calls it a 'masterwork,' praises the production quality and cast. Minor criticisms about lost provocativeness and predictability don't diminish overall enthusiasm. Confident this will be 'viable' - implicit recommendation.
